name: GKSoft Yacht Booking
author: Gksoft Dev Team

sections.description:
GKSoft Yacht Charter Booking (Lite) lets you manage Marinas and Yachts, then embed a modern booking form with an interactive map (Leaflet + OpenStreetMap). Booking requests are saved in WordPress and can be managed from the admin panel.

Lite = booking-only. This version does not take payments.

Highlights
* No API keys required (Leaflet + OpenStreetMap tiles)
* Create & manage marinas (with coordinates)
* Create & manage yachts (image, base price, currency, features)
* Frontend booking form with yacht cards and live total
* Booking completed screen (thank you + summary + contact number)
* Admin booking management: filters, date range, quick actions, detail view
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Yacht Booking → Marinas and add at least one marina (include latitude/longitude)
  4. Go to Yacht Booking → Yachts and add at least one yacht (image + price)
  5. Add shortcode [gksoft_yacht_booking] to any page
  6. Done — test a booking from the frontend
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce is not required. This plugin works as a booking request system.

Does this plugin require a Google Maps / API key?

No. The map uses Leaflet with OpenStreetMap tiles.

Can I accept payments?

Not in Lite. You can later add an optional payment integration (WooCommerce / Stripe) as an add-on.

Where are bookings stored?

Bookings are saved as a custom post type in the admin (Yacht Booking → Bookings) with all booking details stored as meta.
